title: Other MCP Server Smoke Test
goal: Test the configured non-HubSpot MCP servers with safe read-only/status smoke checks and record which are ready, blocked, or require credentials/configuration.

included: Microsoft Graph MCP credential/status smoke check
DOCX local MCP guarded read smoke check
Office/PPTX MCP guarded read smoke check
QNAP MCP status/list smoke check within policy boundaries
excluded: HubSpot MCP, already verified in the previous deterministic setup test
Any write, delete, upload, publish, or credential mutation
Printing secrets, tokens, OAuth codes, or private document contents beyond bounded test outputs

constraints: All tests must be read-only or preview-only.
Do not change MCP client configuration or credentials.
Use MCP tools for actual server smoke checks where available.
Record progress and results in Serena memory.

tasks.title: Inventory configured MCP servers
acceptanceCriteria: opencode mcp list or equivalent status is captured

tasks.title: Run read-only smoke checks for API-backed MCP servers
acceptanceCriteria: Gitea MCP responds to a read-only call
Microsoft Graph MCP reports credential readiness or clear blocker
QNAP MCP reports policy/credential readiness or clear blocker

tasks.title: Run guarded local-file MCP smoke checks
acceptanceCriteria: DOCX MCP handles a bounded workspace-local test document
Office/PPTX MCP handles a bounded workspace-local test presentation or reports a clear blocker
No existing user documents are modified

tasks.title: Run Serena MCP smoke check
acceptanceCriteria: Serena MCP memory or symbol tool responds
No project configuration changes are made

tasks.title: Summarize MCP server readiness
acceptanceCriteria: Each tested server has PASS, WARN, or BLOCKED status
Final result is written to memory

doneWhen: All configured non-HubSpot MCP servers have a recorded read-only smoke result.
No MCP configuration or credentials were changed.
A final readiness matrix is recorded.
